column1: # The data build of the 30B NARROWLY filtered arm, V2 (canary OR `judge_score >= 4`, every
# document judged; the split names say `gpt55_4plus_v2`), one line per corpus, consumed by
# configs/control_pretraining/build_corpora.sh. Column semantics are documented in the baseline's
# table, configs/control_pretraining/30b_baseline/corpora.tsv, and the filtered family's
# differences in configs/control_pretraining/30b_filtered_mini_2plus/corpora.tsv. What is specific
# to this arm is V1's (30b_filtered_gpt55_4plus/corpora.tsv), and restated here because a copied
# table is where it goes wrong:
# - This arm has ONE stage of its own, midtraining, warm-started from the Broadly Filtered arm's
#   pretraining final. So every row here is `midtraining` — INCLUDING ai_safety_and_adjacent,
#   which the two three-stage arms tag `pretraining` because their stage 1 reads it too. Copying
#   that tag here would make `build_corpora.sh <table> midtraining` plan nine corpora of ten and
#   leave out the AI-safety corpus the study is about, with every other check clean. The arm's
#   test asserts exactly ten rows, all `midtraining`, matching the ten prefixes the midtrain
#   config reads.
# - Every subset is the `_filtered_gpt55_4plus_v2` split, and `docs` is that split's RETAINED
#   document count, the `n_retained` of `filter_stats_gpt55_4plus_v2` at the revision the prepare
#   config pins (c6419e3c) — the tokenize job's provenance `num_documents` must equal it
#   (verify_corpora.py checks exactly that). Nothing is sliced: the midtraining corpora are all
#   single-root prepares.
# Walltimes are V1's for the same corpora: a V2 corpus is at most V1's size (V2 judges the queues V1
# left unjudged, so it can only remove more).
# Only nemotron_stem_sft is token-for-token identical to the baseline's build here (the cut
# removes nothing from it); ai_safety_and_adjacent, nemotron_wiki_rewrite and
# nemotron_wiki_rewrite_ai_docs retain exactly V1's document counts. All ten are still built as
# this arm's own copies, as V1's were, for V1's reason: every prefix carrying the
# `_filtered_gpt55_4plus_v2` suffix (a test asserts it) is what makes a prefix pointing at another
# arm's corpus impossible to write by accident.
